calls.title: GrowthBook Messaging
calls.summary: The team reviewed the messaging strategy, defining core pillars like shipping faster safely, learning quickly, and scaling products with AI embedded throughout. They prioritized the target audience of 'product builders' over broader terms, aiming for clarity in communication. Upcoming features for versions 5.1 and 5.2 were discussed, including contextual bandits and real-time results. The consolidation of prospect call data revealed challenges in customer insights, indicating a need to streamline recording tools. Documentation updates and transparency in telemetry practices were also highlighted as essential for improving user trust and data quality. The meeting concluded with assignments to draft elevator pitches and schedule future discussions regarding the roadmap.
calls.keywords: Messaging, AI Roadmap, Product Builders, Experimentation, Feature Flagging, Telemetry
